title: Add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG agent example templates and tool-calling quickstarts to redwood-examples and updates the docs site navigation and quickstart pages. Motivation: provide opinionated, copy-pasteable examples for customers evaluating RAG+agents end-to-end and to reduce support tickets about tool-calling integration patterns. Changes include three example playbooks (faq-bot, support-triage, knowledge-extractor), a tool-calling cookbook with retries/authorization patterns, updated Quickstarts landing page, and new sidebar taxonomy for agents and tool-calling. Checklist: - [x] add example repos and templates - [x] add docs pages and sidebar entries - [x] add unit + integration examples for tool invocation - [x] add tests and CI docs-preview config - [x] manual review from docs + SDK teams Related: Linear ENG-1982, ENG-2015. See internal doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1982/rag-agent-quickstarts
